newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWASE-ROMA'S DAHLIN TO RETURN TO GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWASE-ROMA'S DAHLIN TO RETURN TO GERMANY.

text.p: Serie A club Roma have sent Swedish striker Martin Dahlin back to his former German club Borussia Moenchengladbach for the rest of the season, Italian newspapers reported on Saturday.
Corriere dello Sport daily said the two sides reached an agreement under which he would return to Moenchengladbach on loan until the end of the season with an option of a permanent move after that.

Dahlin, who signed for Roma in the close season, scored 50 goals in 106 games for the Germans but failed to secure a place in the Italian club's first team. Meanwhile, Moenchengladbach have struggled in the Bundesliga.

Roma, who have lost two successive matches sice beating league champions AC Milan 3-0, face European champions Juventus at home later on Saturday in a match which could give a clearer picture of their true worth.
